summary: The current Phase 2 contract is sequential, stateful, and file-based; the main risks are concurrent state mutation, ambiguous finding identity, and incomplete host fallback semantics. The repository also has a legacy `.agent` workflow twin and no parity coverage for `sdd-proposal` itself.

suggestions.title: Make the parent the sole state writer
suggestions.rationale: The current loop updates `state.json` after every query. Forks should write only lane-scoped findings and return receipts; the parent must aggregate counters and transition phases, otherwise concurrent writes can corrupt `consumed`, `phase`, and resume metadata.

suggestions.title: Add explicit lane state and idempotent resume
suggestions.rationale: The existing resume rule restarts an entire phase when it was left `running`, but pre-existing lane files would then be duplicated or re-counted. Optional per-lane status, query IDs, errors, and a merge receipt are needed so retries can safely detect completed work.

suggestions.title: Define one global deadline and quota semantics
suggestions.rationale: The documented budget is global, while the proposed lane percentages introduce separate caps and a per-lane `0.7` timeout. Define integer rounding, whether unused quota is reclaimable, and reserve time for joining, merging, and checkpointing under the single `max_wall_seconds` deadline.

suggestions.title: Partition only dependency-safe queries
suggestions.rationale: The research plan explicitly allows `wiki_page` to consume IDs from an earlier `wiki_query`, and recursive follow-ups carry `parent_id` and depth. Type-based partitioning must preserve those intra-lane dependencies and explicitly defer or record cross-lane follow-ups instead of silently dropping them.

suggestions.title: Keep lane findings out of the Phase 3 input set
suggestions.rationale: Phase 3 currently concatenates `findings/*.md`, while lane IDs such as `FC-001` do not match the canonical `F001` convention shown by the finding template. Write canonical findings only after merge, keep lane artifacts under a non-matching audit location, and validate the canonical set before synthesis.

suggestions.title: Deduplicate by citation identity, not file path
suggestions.rationale: The synthesis contract grounds claims by path, symbol, and line range. A file-path-only merge can combine unrelated functions from the same file and lose provenance; merge only overlapping `(path, symbol, line range)` citations and preserve distinct symbols as separate findings.

suggestions.title: Use a capability probe for Agent dispatch
suggestions.rationale: The Codex adaptation explicitly says not to assume Claude Agent or Task runtime features. Probe availability before launching any lane, use the existing sequential executor when unavailable, and record the fallback reason; also define whether one failed lane triggers a full sequential retry or a degraded result.

suggestions.title: Update and test every workflow surface
suggestions.rationale: The repository contains `.agent/workflows/sdd-proposal.md` in addition to the two surfaces named in the brief, and the existing twin-parity test excludes `sdd-proposal`. Updating only `.claude` and `.agents` can leave the legacy workflow stale; add this command to parity/contract coverage.

suggestions.title: Test deterministic orchestration invariants
suggestions.rationale: The implementation needs tests for lane partitioning, wiki dependency ordering, exact quota accounting, timeout cancellation, partial-lane failure, fallback execution, canonical ID uniqueness, dedup preservation, and resume after merge interruption. These behaviors are not protected by the current twin test.

suggestions.title: Do not pass untrusted source text as fork instructions
suggestions.rationale: The workflow accepts raw Jira, inline, and file content, and the planner embeds that raw source in its prompt. Full-context forks increase prompt-injection and unintended-write risk; pass a minimal immutable lane brief, restrict writes to the findings directory, and revalidate every citation in the parent.

suggestions.title: Resolve custom-budget behavior before adding lane overrides
suggestions.rationale: The state schema already permits `budget.profile: custom`, but the command usage and research-plan contract document only tight/default/loose. Either keep custom sequential for this change or specify and validate per-lane custom limits without changing existing flag semantics.
